name: 2006 Tōkaidō Shinkansen train control upgrade
description: JR Central introduced replacement ground and onboard automatic train control equipment. The upgrade enabled the onboard system to calculate a continuous braking pattern in place of multiple braking steps.

date.label: March 2006
date.basis: The cited source dates this event.

events.statement: JR Central began using the new automatic train control system on the Tōkaidō Shinkansen.

evidence.supports: Dates deployment of the new control system.
Identifies the replacement system and line.

links.statement: The 2006 control equipment was an upgrade to automatic train control on the operating Tōkaidō Shinkansen.

evidence.supports: Describes renewal of existing automatic train control on the railway.
The operator identifies ATC as one component of the dedicated line's operating system.
